dossiers.title: Until Then
dossiers.summary: Evidence summary: 9 validated structured observations; consult observations and conflicts for supported findings.

observations.statement: The story's grounded teen friendships, family relationships, loss and memory themes frequently prompt strong emotional reactions, with relatable dialogue and characters carrying most of the experience.
This dialogue-led visual novel uses mostly linear scenes and small daily-life interactions rather than complex combat or broad exploration; interactive mini-games punctuate the storytelling.

The long narrative and repeated cycles generate disagreement: some find the slow growth of attachments essential, while others believe later routes prolong material that would be stronger with a shorter arc.
Detailed pixel-art environments, animation and music are frequently singled out as strengths, with a recognizable contemporary Philippine setting making the story feel distinctive.

Reaching the first ending does not necessarily resolve the whole mystery; continuing through later cycles can add context and change how earlier scenes are understood, though not all players find these runs rewarding.
Returning to the same characters and places in subsequent story cycles rewards those invested in their development, yet others describe stretched-out repetitions and excessive reading.
Long stretches of text, limited consequences from individual dialogue selections and an occasionally slow opening are practical barriers for those expecting more hands-on play.
The handling of the final twists and emotional tone divides players: several praise the eventual catharsis, while some find the themes overexplained or the ending less meaningful than earlier scenes.
Some Russian-language players report relying on an unofficial Russian fan translation, while the official Steam supported-language list omits Russian.

dossiers.title: Mister Furry: Hot Muscles
dossiers.summary: Evidence summary: 8 validated structured observations; consult observations and conflicts for supported findings.

observations.statement: The short dungeon-escape loop revolves around searching themed areas for collectibles and completing side objectives while avoiding roaming pursuers rather than traditional RPG combat.
Players often treat the exaggerated furry horror premise, absurd dialogue and deliberately provocative presentation as an ironic comedy or social joke rather than serious horror storytelling.
Multiple themed rooms and levels, collection goals and numerous achievements give brief completion targets, but sustained narrative development and gameplay variety are limited.

A detailed recent player review criticizes rudimentary assets, barely developed story and poor optimization despite choosing a tongue-in-cheek positive rating; isolated criticism does not establish universal technical problems.
Some players enjoy the music, character design and unexpectedly amusing atmosphere, while praise is frequently exaggerated for comic effect and should not be treated as conventional enthusiasm.
Players describe achievement hunting and room objectives as achievable within a short playthrough, with some later activities presenting more challenge than the basic collectible search.
A Russian player review references playing online with others after cooperative play was added; this is an optional additional way to experience the dungeon, not evidence that solo play is blocked.
Short playtimes and simple retrieval objectives make the experience more of a novelty for some than a mechanically deep or highly replayable horror adventure.

dossiers.title: Citizen Sleeper
dossiers.summary: Evidence summary: 9 validated structured observations; consult observations and conflicts for supported findings.

observations.statement: Each daily cycle supplies a limited pool of dice, and assigning their values to jobs or timed story clocks balances resources, risk and narrative exploration rather than action combat.
Several parallel character arcs and deadlines can be pursued on a compact space station in flexible order, with strong personal stories rather than a single linear quest dominating play.
The early scarcity of food, condition-restoring medicine and good dice creates effective pressure, but improving skills and repeatable resources often remove urgency later.
Once resources become plentiful, stacking positive dice results into repeated progress clocks can turn late objectives into a rote cycle that no longer carries much narrative tension.
The hand-drawn character art, atmospheric soundscape, communal bonds and cyberpunk themes of personhood, debt and corporate ownership receive strong praise.

Skill improvements, narrative choices, task clocks and different endpoints support a flexible arc, but some players say builds ultimately converge and major decisions have milder effects than expected.

The predominantly text-and-menu presentation, substantial reading and absence of manual reloading under a single-save design are drawbacks for players expecting an action RPG or extensive choice rollback.
Responses to the political science-fiction writing differ: some praise intimate, compassionate characters, while others find its ideological framing simplistic or dialogue heavy.
Russian-language players discuss using community-made Russian translations; the official product language list does not include Russian, making long-form reading an accessibility barrier for some.
